name: Dithered Footer
summary: A light footer with a newsletter form and link columns, closed by a band where the brand is set over a drifting dot field that a pointer spotlight reveals.
useWhen: A product or developer tool wants a textured, retro-digital closing band with its name in it
A newsletter sign-up should sit beside links in the footer
avoidWhen: The brand name must stay readable as plain text in a screenshot or print, because the wordmark is decorative; show the name in the left column too
The app needs a quiet footer, because the dot field keeps moving while it is on screen; use a plain footer instead
